scope: Retain original audit bytes as a historical container, selecting only static binary/source facts listed here. The broad original audit script is provenance, not a promised whole-audit replay entry after this selection.

replacement_dynamic_evidence.gate: Run the existing report generator and independent publication audit after source thaw, verify all 9 unique-stripe samples and exact CUPTI launch fields, before deleting old SQLite/metadata.
